utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Kira, have you heard any updates about the repair drive yet? I’m trying to keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet, Tess—has someone confirmed the date and what repairs they’re actually taking on?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not confirmed yet, but I’ll check with the organizers today and let you know as soon as I hear the date and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I was just checking in about the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think we’re still gathering what needs fixing and who can bring tools, but I might’ve missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—so you’re still collecting repair needs and tool volunteers; I’ll pass that along and ask around for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Ira, what repairs are we collecting for first, and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the final list yet, Leo, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll ask around on my errands and let you know where they decide drop-off should be.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira. Just send me the confirmed list and drop-off spot when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I don’t know much about the repair drive yet. What are folks hoping to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: From what I’ve heard, folks want to start with the leaky community shed roof and a few broken porch rails, then take stock of tools and materials after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense, starting with the roof before more gets damaged. Do you know who’s keeping the list of tools we already have?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, I’m trying to plan around school pickup—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking we start around 3:30 so folks can swing by after pickup, and keep it going until about 6. Does that work for your school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works well for me—pickup wraps up around 3, so I can help set up right after and stay until about 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive, Oren; I’d like us to set a clear date, a simple list of tasks, and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds wise, Eli—before I forget, let’s pick a Saturday morning and jot down tools, snacks, and who can handle sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning suits me; let’s choose the 15th at nine, and I’ll start a checklist for tools, snacks, and sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m glad I caught you—there’s a repair drive coming up, and I’m trying to make sure everyone on the block hears about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds useful—when and where is it, and do they need people to sign up ahead of time?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and no sign-up needed—just bring whatever needs fixing, and I’ll spread the word to the rest of the block too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rosa, I’m still catching up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell! We’re gathering requests this week and matching them with volunteers, so the big thing now is getting neighbors to send in what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—that helps. I’ll spread the word and tell folks to send in their repair requests this week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara, before we jump in, can you tell me which repairs are most urgent and who has already offered supplies or help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have any confirmed notes yet on urgent repairs or who’s offered supplies, Hana. Let’s start by listing the repair needs and any offers people have already mentioned so I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Mara—let’s start a simple list with the repair need, location, urgency, and any person who mentioned supplies or help, even if it’s not confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t have much to give right now, but I can help sort tools or carry things if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be plenty useful, Uli—I’m probably joining late myself, so having someone steady on sorting or carrying would really help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can do that. Just tell me where to be and I’ll keep out of the way unless you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I’ve got a couple toolboxes and a spare drill I can bring for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps, Gus. Can you also bring drill bits and an extension cord, or should I track those down?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring both—I've got a full bit set and a heavy-duty extension cord, so you can cross those off your list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Bo, I’m starting a location list for the repair drive so we know exactly where tools, parts, and drop-off bins are set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Opal — put me down to check the garage and side shed later, but I’m a bit slammed right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ll mark you for the garage and side shed later, and I won’t count them checked until you confirm.
